title: Project Coordinator & QA
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Location:** Ramanathapuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Work Mode:** Office

**Salary:** ₹23000 to 30000

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for a **QA & Project Coordinator** to support software quality assurance and coordinate project activities. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, organized, and capable of coordinating effectively with development, QA, and project teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Perform functional, regression, integration, and UI testing
* Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios
* Identify, document, and track bugs through resolution
* Coordinate with developers and project teams for issue resolution
* Monitor project tasks, timelines, priorities, and deliverables
* Track project progress and provide regular status updates
* Understand project requirements and assist in requirement discussions
* Support UAT, deployment, and release activities
* Maintain QA and project-related documentation
* Ensure projects are delivered with expected quality and within timelines

REQUIREMENTS

* 1–3 years of experience in **QA, Software Testing, or Project Coordination**
* Good understanding of **SDLC, STLC, and Software Testing concepts**
* Experience in manual testing and test case preparation
* Good knowledge of bug tracking and issue management
* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Knowledge of tools such as **Jira, Trello, or similar tools** is an advantage

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

**Software Testing, Manual Testing, QA, Project Coordination, IT Projects, Web Applications, UAT, Bug Tracking, or Software Development.**

WHAT WE OFFER

* Career Growth Opportunities
* Learning & Development
* Exposure to Real-World IT Projects
* Collaborative & Professional Work Environment
* Opportunity to grow in **QA & Project Management**

**Join our team and grow with us!**

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
